issues.what: Duplicate chapter title: ch1, ch2 and ch5 are all 'The Widow's Instructions'
The 'this is my flat' sketch reveal happens again as if new (already done in ch1 and ch2), and Minyue asks Fang's name though she has known it since ch1
issues.quote: “It is my flat,” Minyue said. “Down to the crack.”

issues.what: Says Minyue owns no television; in ch1 her TV's red standby light is on the cabinet
issues.quote: though she owned no television, only a laptop closed on the cabinet

issues.what: Walls are built again though the house has had pale yellow walls since ch1; shop is placed on Wenming Road; the timeline to the festival doesn't add up (two weeks, then nine days, then five, then burning on day 8); it is set in late July, which is too early for Ghost Festival
issues.quote: “Nine days,” Hu said without looking up. “We start the walls.”

issues.what: Backstory drift: Fang did payroll (ch3) but here sews linings; the landlord (ch3) becomes a factory; her heart becomes a blood vessel; the photo is a different riverbank shot; the jade beads are at her throat; the mole moves to her lip
issues.quote: She died on that stool in 2009. A blood vessel.

issues.what: Ending: 'three wooden chairs' and a canvas stool left folded 'that first morning', which contradicts the wooden stool Minyue never moved
issues.quote: The table held three wooden chairs, pushed in.

issues.what: Scar on inside of widow's wrist reads as a suicide hint the brief says to avoid
issues.quote: a faded scar along the inner wrist, thin and white

issues.what: Opening paragraph copies ch3's opening almost word for word
issues.quote: The shop smelled of paste before the shutters were fully up.

issues.what: Bowing to a customer reads as Japanese custom, not Cantonese shop manners
issues.quote: Hu stood and bowed a little. Minyue bowed too.

issues.what: The Minyue-made blouse and the salt line are credited to the wrong person; floorboards in a tiled flat
issues.quote: She had cut it herself three days ago from tissue

fix: Retitle ch2-5. Ch3: replace the repeated sketch reveal with new slip details and make the name question 'tell me about her'; walls become floor/furniture; fix nineteen->all years. Ch2: TV, scar, name repeat. Ch4/5: timeline, photo, backstory, stool, chairs, beads, mole, cultural nods.
praise: Domestic dread done beautifully: a fourth stool, soup warm on a cold stove, and a paper face that changes each morning, all ending in a tender, earned send-off by the river.

issues.what: Duplicate chapter title with ch1 ('Ten Seconds Early')
Anouk already does the 'speak first, the delegate follows' test in ch1, so ch3's 'proper test' and Jules's 'You spoke first' repeat it as if it were new
issues.quote: She opened her microphone and repeated the voice's words into Dutch before the delegate spoke.

issues.what: Pen continuity: Priya gave the lost pen back in ch3, yet here it is the 'lost pen' on the desk
issues.quote: On the desk lay Anouk’s lost pen, the one Priya had found under the duct

issues.what: The reveal line is reused in ch3 and ch4 as if it were new
issues.quote: The voice had finished his sentence before he had begun it.

issues.what: Jules says 'So tomorrow I requested transfers', which is a tense slip
issues.quote: So tomorrow I requested transfers for a year.
Two o clock in the morning.

fix: Retitle ch4. Ch1: let the delegate echo the voice without Anouk speaking first, so ch3 holds the test. Ch3/ch4: vary the reveal line; ch4 pen is one Anouk had pocketed; fix Jules's tense, o'clock typos.
praise: The sound design of the dread (flat logs, her own voice a half second behind, the feedback loop that ends it) is sleek and original.
